description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Fencasfen Quomir)
- Vendor B (Drasanbel Risantal)
- Vendor C (Ozmirans Sobreoz)
- Vendor D (Taltho Vapolri)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Fencasfen Quomir):
  - Vendor A offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor A performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor A is financially stable
  - Vendor A allows workflow customisation
Vendor B (Drasanbel Risantal):
  - Vendor B has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor B had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor B allows no customisation
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 370 thousand per year
  - Vendor B reported 0 major outages last year
